title: Whole Turkey (frozen)

drivers.name: Heatwave (38°C)
drivers.evidence: No historical heatwave effect observed; recent weeks show no heat-related drop; but high temps may reduce demand for large frozen items. Noise-adjusted estimate shrinks effect toward 1.0.

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes. Heatwave (38°C) may reduce demand for frozen turkey, as high temps discourage large holiday meal prep and increase spoilage concerns. Historical data shows no consistent heatwave effect, and recent weeks show no spike despite similar heat. The baseline trend is rising (44% 13-week growth), but the heatwave may dampen it. No strong evidence supports a lift or drop. The classical model suggests 1.0, and noise-adjusted evidence supports no change. Confidence is low due to weak signal.
